brief:
The Gaza petroleum authority announced Sunday that five trucks carrying cooking gas had entered the territory, according to Shehab Wire. The shipment represents a rare delivery of fuel to the coastal enclave, which has faced severe shortages of essential supplies in recent months.

The arrival of the gas trucks underscores the acute scarcity of cooking fuel affecting residents across Gaza. Cooking gas has become a critical shortage item, with limited supplies reaching the territory through border crossings.
title: Five cooking gas trucks enter Gaza strip
